'''1999 GenCon EPP Overdrive''' was an [[EPP Overdrive]] event at Gen Con in Milwaukee, Wisconsin on 6 August 1999. [[Tim Guzman]] named it in his Outer Rim Gen-Con 99' report.<ref name="or-gen">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/GenCon99.htm Gen-Con 99'], The Outer Rim (The Information Broker). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261030141408/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/GenCon99.htm Internet Archive]</ref> It was played alongside the [[1999 GenCon Open]].

* '''Date:''' 6 August 1999
* '''Site:''' Milwaukee, Wisconsin
* '''Format:''' [[EPP Overdrive]]
